answer: Every identity must anchor to a hardware-entropy fingerprint: a VDF seed drawn from GPU ring-oscillator jitter, unique per chip like basalt strata, unclonable in software. Registration locks 1,500 POA for 45 days; each epoch the agent re-proves jitter inside a 2% band, so copies fail. A farm renting 200 virtual GPUs locks 300,000 POA in bonds, and any batch where over 40% of fingerprints share one ferrous-batch signature freezes it with a 100% slash. A 150-agent garden of clones was caught when 132 jitter samples matched one chip's drift curve exactly.
